```yaml
name: Build and Release

on:
  push:
    branches: [master]
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'pyproject.toml'
      - '.github/workflows/_build-and-release.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

# Restrict permissions by default
permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  # Skip if commit is from semantic-release
  check-skip:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      should_skip: ${{ steps.check.outputs.should_skip }}
    steps:
      - name: Check if should skip
        id: check
        env:
          # Use env var to avoid shell interpretation of backticks in commit messages
          COMMIT_MSG: ${{ github.event.head_commit.message }}
        run: |
          if [[ "$COMMIT_MSG" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+ ]] || [[ "$COMMIT_MSG" =~ "chore(release)" ]]; then
            echo "should_skip=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "should_skip=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

  # Build and release dev versions
  build-dev:
    name: Build Dev Release
    needs: check-skip
    if: needs.check-skip.outputs.should_skip != 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: '3.13'

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7
        with:
          version: "latest"

      - name: Create virtual environment and install dependencies
        run: |
          uv venv .venv
          uv pip install -e .
        shell: bash

      - name: Generate dev version
        id: version
        run: |
          SHORT_SHA=$(echo "${{ github.sha }}" | cut -c1-7)
          DEV_VERSION="dev-${SHORT_SHA}"
          echo "version=$DEV_VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "short_sha=$SHORT_SHA" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "Dev version: $DEV_VERSION"

      - name: Create draft release
        id: create_release
        uses: release-drafter/release-drafter@v6
        with:
          name: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
          tag: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
          version: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
          publish: false
          prerelease: true
          prerelease-identifier: dev
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Build binaries
        uses: ./.github/workflows/build-binary.yml
        with:
          version: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
          release_id: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.id }}
          release_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.html_url }}

  # Build and release stable versions
  build-stable:
    name: Build Stable Release
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && startsWith(github.event.head_commit.message, 'chore(release):')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: '3.13'

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7
        with:
          version: "latest"

      - name: Create virtual environment and install dependencies
        run: |
          uv venv .venv
          uv pip install -e .
        shell: bash

      - name: Get version from commit message
        id: version
        run: |
          VERSION=$(echo "${{ github.event.head_commit.message }}" | grep -oE 'chore\(release\): [0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' | cut -d' ' -f3)
          echo "version=$VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "Version: $VERSION"

      - name: Create release
        id: create_release
        uses: release-drafter/release-drafter@v6
        with:
          name: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
          tag: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
          version: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
          publish: false
          prerelease: false
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Build binaries
        uses: ./.github/workflows/build-binary.yml
        with:
          version: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
          release_id: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.id }}
          release_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.html_url }}
```
